description: Evaluates the completeness and quality of media production pre-production briefs, ensuring all logistical, creative, and organizational requirements are covered before a shoot.

criteria.question: Does the shot list include all three pillars (video, drone, photo)? (yes/no)
Does the equipment checklist specify camera models? (yes/no)
Is a Lark channel creation step included? (yes/no)
Does the schedule include setup and teardown time? (yes/no)
Is the client name referenced in the output? (yes/no)
